description: Email a copy of one received or sent message (with its stored attachments) to another address, such as a teammate. Notes cannot be forwarded. The forward is recorded in the conversation as a system message and does not change its status or unread state. Each successful call sends another copy, so after a timeout check the conversation with get_conversation before retrying.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

messageId.description: ID of the message to forward, from get_conversation.

senderProfileId.description: Optional sender profile to forward from. Omit to use the company default sender.

to.description: One email address to forward the message to.

name: forward_conversation_message

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `forward_conversation_message` MCP tool.

forward.description: The conversation forward record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
